items.text: Soulforged,
We've just set a new build live, containing a few bug fixes.
Summary of bugs now fixed;
Arthur Pendragon cannot be struck by Soul Missiles fired from Cliona blessings
Character could become soft‑locked after teleporting into doors in certain rooms
Dagonet's poison trail deals damage to the playable character while they are using the ultimate ability
The Piercing Shards upgrade causes inconsistent behaviour with the Monk's Crystal Turrets
Player with Bloody Shadows blessing cannot obtain Bloody Thinner blessing
Vigilante character with Vengeful Blade upgrade does not receive Shrine blessings
Fixed an issue where, under certain conditions, the default potion would not be set correctly and cause interactables in Carmarthen to not function until the game was reloaded
We want to let you know about an important update.

A recently identified security vulnerability within Unity has been spotted, and while there is currently no evidence of impact on users, we’re taking all relevant steps to ensure you’re on the latest and safest version of the game.
To keep you safe, we’ve released a new patch that addresses the issue. Please update your game as soon as possible to stay protected.

notes.title: You can read more about it here

notes.title: Friends List, Discord, and Voice Chat

items.text: We have now made it easier to play with your friends. Open the new Friends List to see your online Steam Friends. Connect your Discord Account to also see and play with your friends from Discord.
Additionally, Voice Chat powered by Discord has been added to make it easier to communicate with your teammates, regardless if you have linked your Discord account or not.

Arthur has brought in some reinforcements! Three new alternate Bosses have been introduced. When playing on Knight difficulty or higher, these new foes can sometimes appear at the end of a Biome instead of the Boss you normally would encounter.

Though corrupted, Lady Kay remains a stalwart warrior in service to Arthur. She guards the entrance to Cornwall with her gigantic shield, pummeling down any who dare challenge Arthur’s rule. Her greatshield is not unbreakable, however, and if the Soulforged can find a way to power through her defenses, they have a shot at taking her down.

notes.title: Sir Dagonet, Grasp of The Mire

items.text: This gluttonous former Knight revels in his newfound power, delighted at any new playthings entering his swamp. His devastating hook can render Soulforged immobile, as he drags them around his swamp filled with traps and poison. Clever warriors will need to dismantle his fixtures around the arena, before they drown in Sir Dagonet’s mire.

The source of much of the shipwrecks and current state of Deep Harbor, Lady Agravain has been rendered completely mad from her transformation. In a flurry of feathers and steel, this terrifying adversary dashes around her nest with breakneck speed, ripping unprepared Soulforged to shreds. Only those able to read her movements have a chance at keeping up.
